delivered: History offers distinct native Todo restoration, unarchive, exact zero-effect Daily correction and linked Habitica uncheck reviews. A bounded retained-record browser includes archived tasks without completions and terminal Daily skips.

Native previews bind exact archive/occurrence revision and original source; original receipts remain visible after acknowledgement loss. Linked reviews show the task/completion/account/day/native identity, unknown resource effects and original receipt identity.

Scoped recovery ownership blocks replacement task/organization preparation and source switching. Lost preparation retries the same request; attempted acceptance reads the original command only. Active original recovery can be rediscovered after reopening the same completion, and manual command-ID lookup never scores.

Filters, task drafts and exact source identity remain independent. Account changes clear private recovery data. Missing proof, explicit archive-reference repair, stale/expired reviews and bounded server refusal codes remain visible without unlinked copies or erased history.
Required reviewed MCP discovery exposes the same archived/terminal browse through existing scopes and bounded canonical reads; no permanent browser-automation workflow is introduced.

qualification.scope: Synthetic Razor and production assets; component dispatch and native HTML keyboard are separate; physical devices/AT/live accounts unqualified

repairs: The Daily skip fixture requires an explicit valid schedule.
The canonical text-folding helper is public for the shared UI query; a focused full-width search test verifies parity without changing saved task text.

Shared-route fixture compilation used the current bUnit API and local page storage/browser fakes. An implicit conditional-constructor type inferred the linked fake for native cases; explicit base construction restored exact fixture identity. No production identity validation was weakened.
Unconfirmed acceptance now labels the original review as unconfirmed; the shared panel identifies recovery ownership instead of incorrectly suggesting a different cloud owner.
Server error messages expose only bounded code syntax; arbitrary response text remains hidden.
limitations: Local synthetic sources, SDK/HTTP composition and Razor/native HTML controls only; no real account/provider score, Cron, host, device, notification permission, assistive-technology or publication operation.

Blazor dispatch is component-test evidence. Native keyboard and rendered geometry/contrast are separate browser evidence. Screenshots show visible desktop crops rather than full phone/device qualification.
Disabled text is excluded from the existing automated contrast sampler; disabled geometry/visibility and distinguishable states remain covered, with manual light/Obsidian inspection.
Archive reference repair requires an explicit repair patch through the existing contract; the history UI explains the prerequisite and never silently removes references.

The eighteen primary history fixtures have empty secondary archive queries. The later query-normalization change leaves the measured rendered branches unchanged; canonical full-width search behavior is separately tested.
The required MCP child retains the independent Miniflare proxy transport limitation and successful isolated lifecycle evidence.

timing.instrumentation: Per-control tool wall time and deadlines are recorded; browser measurement and server waiting are not active controller-time estimates.
